end.parentNote: Kabir practised estimating before checking an exact answer and used nearest-thousand rounding in the examples. They continued to mix up “close to the estimate” with “the same as the estimate,” and this was not corrected by the end. At home, ask them to estimate first, solve exactly, and explain why a nearby answer can still be reasonable.
